source: 5 is made of 2 and 3. 2 plus 3 equals 5.
spoken: Let's be number detectives! Look at 5. It hides two smaller numbers, 2 and 3. 2 plus 3 equals 5. Can you spot them? 🔍

source: The ten-frame has 9 dots and 1 empty spot. 9 plus 1 equals 10. 10 minus 1 equals 9.
spoken: Explorers, look at this ten-frame! It has 9 dots and 1 empty spot. Can you see it? 9 plus 1 equals 10. And 10 minus 1 equals 9. 🧭

source: Careful, fourteen is not forty. Fourteen is said ten 4. It means 10 plus 4.
spoken: Careful, explorer! Fourteen is not forty. Fourteen is said ten 4. It means 10 plus 4. You can listen for the ten first.

source: Perimeter is the distance around a rectangle. Trace the outside and count the units. Or add the lengths of all four sides.
spoken: Builders, let's start with the fence around our plan! Perimeter is the distance around a rectangle. You can trace the outside and count the units. Or you can add the lengths of all four sides. 🏗️

source: Use the formulas for the area and perimeter of rectangles.
spoken: Welcome to the building crew! Today you will be the planner of the build. Your mission is to use the formulas for the area and perimeter of rectangles. Ready to build? 🏗️
You were a great detective today! You learned to make a ten to add. What clue helped you most? 🔍
